notes: Cross-make universals — signals whose definition (canId, bit position, scaling) is identical across every leaf the app currently ships. Anything model- or transmission-specific lives downstream in the tree. Validated C-CAN additions include only high and medium confidence passive-broadcast decodes from the 2026-06-07 KDMLink/EK1 reconciliation.

signals.name: EngineRPM
signals.description: Engine RPM from CAN 0x316 bytes 2-3 LE. Validated 2026-06-07 dual capture, r2=0.992. Confidence: high.

signals.name: ManifoldPressureHiRes
signals.description: High-resolution charge-pipe absolute pressure from CAN 0x492 EMS19.CR_Ems_BstPre. DBC/JSN-DCT-3: bit20 length12, x1.322 hPa = x0.1322 kPa abs. Confirmed on Elantra N C-CAN 2026-06-16 and Veloster N references; do not decode byte 2 by itself because it is the low nibble of this signal. Confidence: high.

signals.name: FuelRailPressure
signals.description: Fuel rail pressure from CAN 0x5CE bytes 0-1 LE. Validated 2026-06-07 dual capture, r2=0.952. Confidence: high.

signals.name: AcceleratorPedal
signals.description: Accelerator pedal position from CAN 0x329 D6. Validated 2026-06-07 dual capture, r2=0.937. Confidence: high.

signals.name: AirFuelRatio
signals.description: Air/fuel ratio (lambda times 14.7) from CAN 0x4E7 bytes 2-3 LE. Validated 2026-06-07 dual capture, r2=0.919. Confidence: high.

signals.name: ThrottlePosition
signals.description: Throttle position from CAN 0x329 bytes 4-5 LE. Validated 2026-06-07 dual capture, r2=0.912. Confidence: medium-high.

signals.name: ActualMAP
signals.description: Candidate post-throttle manifold absolute pressure from CAN 0x557 D4. Validated 2026-06-07 dual capture against charge-pipe pressure, r2=0.857. Confidence: medium.

signals.name: InjectionTime
signals.description: Injection time from CAN 0x556 bytes 4-5 LE. Validated 2026-06-07 dual capture, r2=0.876. Confidence: medium.

signals.name: LateralAccel
signals.description: Lateral acceleration from CAN 0x49D. Unsigned 16-bit LE, center 32768 = 0G.

signals.name: SteeringAngle
signals.description: Steering wheel angle from CAN 0x2B0 (positive = right).

signals.name: CoolantTemp
signals.description: Engine coolant temperature from CAN 0x329 D1.

signals.name: TurboPressure
signals.description: Compatibility alias for the exact 0x492 EMS19.CR_Ems_BstPre charge-pipe absolute pressure signal. Same geometry as ManifoldPressureHiRes: bit20 length12, x0.1322 kPa abs. Confidence: high.

signals.name: OilTemp
signals.description: Engine oil temperature from CAN 0x492 D4.

signals.name: Odometer
signals.description: Total odometer reading in cluster display unit (km or miles depending on SpeedUnit).

signals.name: SpeedUnit
signals.description: Cluster speed unit flag from CLU11 (CAN 0x4F1). 0 = km/h, 1 = mph.

signals.name: BoostPressurePsi
signals.description: Gauge-psi form of the exact 0x492 EMS19.CR_Ems_BstPre charge-pipe absolute pressure signal: psi=(raw*0.1322 kPa - 101.325)*0.145038. Matches EK1-style boost pressure and avoids Elantra D2 nibble spikes. Confidence: high.
